description: Translates text into International Morse code (letters A-Z, digits 0-9 and common punctuation). Returns the code with "." and "-", one space between letters and " / " between words, lists any characters that have no Morse code, and gives a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com with the code filled in.

text.description: The text to translate, at most 1000 characters.

name: text_to_morse
title: Text to Morse code
